tool_args.rationale: The pilot is monotone and concave, and the added low- and high-gradient observations address its original sink-gradient ambiguity. Fit the archived smooth sink-coupled candidates numerically and select the best fit for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch probe has widened the gradient range; the observed static sink-coupled candidates are identifiable without a trajectory batch.
Both square-root and linear branches, as well as the archived Hill and barrier mechanisms, are retained as numerical candidates to avoid assuming the branch prematurely.
It does not discriminate the target mechanisms.
